about_the_game:
Compadrone is a family friendly top down roguelite arena shooter in which you play as a drone that been sent to fight off aliens.

The objective of the game is to survive against multiple hordes of invading aliens. Use an Xbox controller or mouse to maneuver your drone across an alien landscape whilst shooting at alien warbots, gaining experience and collecting resources.

Enemy attacks come in waves, with each wave only lasting between 1 to 2 minutes. At the end of each wave you can use the resources you have collected to unlock better weapons and defensive towers. Defensive towers can be placed at strategic locations in the map to further help you in your fight against the aliens.

The game allows you to choose between 9 different types of drones, and features multiple types of aliens. The weapons on your drone fire automatically when aliens come within their range.

short_description: Compadrone is a family friendly top-down arena shooter with elements of tower defense gameplay. You control a drone capable of wielding multiple weapons and fight hordes of alien warbots. Collect resources and XP to unlock new weapons, towers, abilities, and drones.
